title: CARS Scrutineering Form

source.form: Canadian Association of Rallysport Scrutineering Form (D102_2022)
source.rules: CARS Rule Book (National Rally Regulations and Technical Rules), 2026-03 (updated 2026-05-22)

instructions: Overall result: Accepted or Rejected. This vehicle has been inspected for compliance only with CARS regulations. No guarantee regarding the safety of this vehicle is implied.

items.label: Auxiliary lights
items.accepts: Auxiliary lights fitted in bumper/grille/front bodywork with openings fully filled by the lights

items.label: Single switch driving lights
items.accepts: One switch turns off all high beams and auxiliary lights, leaving low beams on

items.label: Helmet
items.accepts: FIA 8860-2010 (expires 2028-12-31), 8859-2015, 8860-2018 or 8859-2024; Snell SA2020 or SA2025. Snell SA2010/SAH2010/SA2015 on the form are no longer accepted for Performance Rally (Rally Sprint also accepts Snell SA2005 or newer). Unmodified

items.label: Helmet identification
items.accepts: Competitor's name clearly marked on the helmet

items.label: Head & Neck restraint system
items.accepts: HANS FIA 8858-2002 or 8858-2010, Hybrid FIA 8858-2010, or SFI 38.1 with conformance label less than 5 years old

items.label: Tether FIA 8858
items.accepts: FIA devices use FIA-homologated tethers with a sewn FIA 8858 label

items.label: Driving suit
items.accepts: FIA 8856-2000, 8856-2018 or FIA 1986; SFI 3-2A/5; SFI 3-2A/1 only with approved fire-resistant underwear; clean, neck to ankles and wrists, no holes or frays

items.label: Undergarments
items.accepts: Approved fire-resistant underwear when the suit is SFI 3-2A/1

items.label: Belts
items.accepts: Unmodified 5- or 6-point FIA 8853/98 or 8853-2016 (not past label expiration) or SFI 16.1/16.5 (manufacture date less than 2 years); no mixed parts. Rally Sprint: min. 5-point in good condition, no expiry restriction

items.label: Belt installation
items.accepts: Lap and crotch straps through the seat, not over the sides; straps protected from sharp edges; anchorages per FIA/SFI guidance

items.label: Seat
items.accepts: FIA 8855-1999, 8862-2009 or 8855-2021, not modified; no hinged-back or OEM seats; replace at 10 years from manufacture (Rally Sprint: fixed-back one-piece FIA seat, no expiry)

items.label: Seat mounting elements
items.accepts: Mounted per FIA App. J Art. 253 Art. 16; no movement possible in an accident

items.label: Seat structure to chassis
items.accepts: Seat securely attached to the floor/chassis; end plates bolted or fully welded

items.label: Roll cage padding
items.accepts: FIA 8857-2001 Type A or SFI 45.1 wherever a helmet could contact the cage; flame-retardant padding where bodies could contact it

items.label: Turbo & restrictor
items.accepts: Forced induction inlet per class (Table A: O4WD 34 mm, 2.5 bar abs), min. 3 mm wide, within 50 mm of the compressor blades

items.label: Turbo seal
items.accepts: Induction system sealed with wire and CARS seal so the restrictor cannot be reached without breaking it

items.label: Exhaust
items.accepts: Functioning catalytic converter (unless registered before one was required); max. 86 dBA at 15 m with engine at 3500 rpm, stationary

items.label: Fuel tank & lines
items.accepts: Original tank, or FIA/SFI fuel cell vented outside with original filler sealed; fire-retardant shield from cockpit; lines through cockpit metal-cased and 200 psi rated; pumps behind metal bulkhead; no supplementary tanks

items.label: Door panels
items.accepts: Inside door panels protect from metal edges

items.label: Secured items
items.accepts: All articles that could be dangerous if loose are securely restrained

items.label: Spill kit
items.accepts: At least 2 x 15" x 19" absorbent pads and 1 x 3" x 48" hydrocarbon sock in a resealable heavy-duty bag

items.label: First Aid kit
items.accepts: Comprehensive kit with the CARS-listed contents in the cockpit, easily accessible and removable

items.label: Sticker
items.accepts: First-aid kit label on the outside of the car at the nearest access point

items.label: Battery
items.accepts: Securely mounted, terminals covered; covered non-conductive box if relocated; sealed type if in the cockpit

items.label: Triangles (3)
items.accepts: 3 self-supporting reflective triangles, min. 30 cm per side, one within reach of a seated crew member

items.label: Triangle identification
items.accepts: Triangles identified/marked for the car

items.label: Extinguisher (<2 yrs)
items.accepts: Two portable extinguishers min. 5 B:C each in the cockpit, min. two quick-release metal fastenings and anti-torpedo tabs, one within reach of a seated crew member; bought, recharged or inspected within 2 years; exterior extinguisher label. On-board (central) system optional: FIA 8865-2015 or SFI 17.1, min. 3 kg, in addition to the two portables

items.label: Extinguisher (<2 yrs)
items.accepts: Second required portable extinguisher, min. 5 B:C, same mounting and 2-year service requirements

items.label: Extinguisher (<2 yrs)
items.accepts: Additional extinguisher or on-board system if fitted; same mounting and 2-year service requirements

items.label: Drivers' names
items.accepts: Driver and co-driver names on the rear side windows, white 5 cm Helvetica bold

items.label: Flags
items.accepts: National or provincial flag, 5 cm high, next to each name

items.label: Windows
items.accepts: Laminated safety-glass windshield; side glass may be replaced with Lexan of equal or greater thickness allowing escape and rescue

items.label: Tint
items.accepts: Crew visible from outside the car

items.label: Sunroof
items.accepts: Metal sunroof fixed closed; non-metal sunroof replaced with metal and fixed closed

items.label: Tires
items.accepts: Tires including spares adequate; studded tires only as permitted and marked at scrutineering

items.label: Suspension
items.accepts: Suspension secure, no damage or excessive play

items.label: Mud flaps & ground clearance
items.accepts: Mud flaps on all rear and driving wheels; min. 5.0 cm ground clearance (excluding tires)

items.label: Tow points: Front/identified
items.accepts: Metal tow eye, min. 3/4" inside diameter, painted yellow, red or orange, with "TOW" sticker

items.label: Tow points: Rear/identified
items.accepts: Metal tow eye, min. 3/4" inside diameter, painted yellow, red or orange, with "TOW" sticker

items.label: Tow rope
items.accepts: Recovery strap carried entirely inside the car
